description:
BRICKS! is a calm, colourful block puzzle. Drag pastel pieces onto a 10×10 board with your mouse or trackpad, fill a row or column to clear it, and see how high you can score.

There are no timers and no ads, and you never need an account. Just you and the board.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Three pieces in your tray at a time, from single bricks to long bars, squares and corners
• Fill a whole row or column to clear it
• Clear two or more lines with one piece for 1.5× points
• Every deal has at least one piece you can place, so a bad hand never ends your run
• The piece sits right under your pointer, and the lines it would clear light up before you let go

GIFTS AND POWER-UPS
Every so often a gift lands on the board with a countdown. Build over it and clear its line in time to win a power-up:
• Hammer: smash a single brick
• Bomb: clear a 3×3 area
• Shuffle: deal three new pieces
• Rotate: turn your whole tray
• Undo: take back your last move
Hold up to five of each, and they carry over to your next game.

GAME CENTER
• 52 achievements, from your first clear to a 25,000-point game
• Daily, weekly and all-time leaderboards
• Challenges to send your friends from the Games app

A NEW SKY EVERY 1,000 POINTS
Hit a milestone and the background melts into one of seven pastel skies.

MADE TO BE COMFORTABLE
• Full dark mode with the same pastel bricks
• Keyboard shortcuts: ⌘N new game, ⌘Z undo, ⌘, settings
• A resizable window that switches to a side-by-side layout when it's wide
• Your game saves after every move, so you can pick up right where you left off

No data collected. No internet needed to play.
promotionalText: A calm block puzzle for your Mac. Drop pastel pieces, fill a line, clear it, and chase 52 Game Center achievements. No ads, no timers, no accounts.
